bib.title: InstructPix2Pix: Learning to Follow Image Editing Instructions

question: Can a diffusion model be trained to edit a real image from a written instruction in one forward pass, using only synthetic training data?
hypothesis: Combining GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to generate paired editing data lets a conditional diffusion model generalise zero-shot to real images and human-written instructions.
contributions: A method to generate a paired image-editing dataset from GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion with Prompt-to-Prompt
InstructPix2Pix, a conditional diffusion model trained on it that edits in the forward pass without per-example inversion or fine-tuning
Classifier-free guidance over two conditionings (image and instruction) with separate scales sI and sT

method.summary: Fine-tune GPT-3 Davinci on 700 hand-written (caption, instruction, edited caption) triplets, generate 454,445 triplets from LAION captions, render before/after image pairs with Stable Diffusion plus Prompt-to-Prompt, filter with CLIP, then fine-tune Stable Diffusion v1.5 with the input image concatenated as extra input channels and the instruction as text conditioning.

datasets.name: Human-written editing triplets
datasets.source: input captions sampled from LAION-Aesthetics V2 6.5+; instructions and output captions written by hand

datasets.name: GPT-3 generated triplets
datasets.source: fine-tuned GPT-3 on real LAION-Aesthetics captions, duplicate captions and duplicate image URLs excluded
datasets.preprocessing: exclude generations where input and output captions are the same

datasets.name: Generated image pairs
datasets.size: 100 pairs per caption pair generated; up to 4 kept per caption pair after filtering; final image-pair count not stated
datasets.preprocessing: CLIP filters: image-image similarity 0.75, image-caption 0.2, directional CLIP similarity 0.2; sort by directional similarity, keep up to 4

models.name: Stable Diffusion v1.5 (EMA weights, ft-MSE autoencoder) + Prompt-to-Prompt
InstructPix2Pix
models.architecture: latent diffusion U-Net with extra input channels on the first conv layer (zt concatenated with E(cI)), new-channel weights zero-initialised
models.init_from: EMA weights of Stable Diffusion v1.5 checkpoint

training.objective: latent diffusion noise-prediction L2 loss conditioned on image latent and text instruction (Eq. 1)
training.regularisation: conditioning dropout: only cI null 5%, only cT null 5%, both null 5%; random horizontal flip; random resize 256-288 then crop 256

other.resolution: 256x256 training; other settings from public Stable Diffusion code base
other.image_pair_gen: 100 denoising steps, Euler ancestral sampler, Karras variance schedule, same latent noise for both images, Prompt-to-Prompt self-attention replacement for first p fraction of steps, p~U(0.1,0.9)

inference.samples: Fig 12 varies latent noise for multiple edits; number of samples per item for quantitative plots not stated
